name: name
doc: mod.xml: name in the mod list. workshop.xml: Workshop item title. Not required by the game, empty if missing

name: description
doc: mod.xml: description in the mod list. workshop.xml: Workshop description; an empty one leaves the Workshop page text unchanged

name: request_no_api_restrictions
doc: mod.xml only. If 1 the mod's lua state opens the full LuaJIT library set (package/require, io, os, debug, ffi) and keeps load/loadstring/collectgarbage. The player must allow unsafe mods, and such mods don't work through the Steam Workshop

name: ui_newgame_name
doc: mod.xml only. Game mode name shown in the new game menu. Only used with is_game_mode="1". Accepts $translation keys

name: ui_newgame_description
doc: mod.xml only. Game mode description shown in the new game menu. Only used with is_game_mode="1". Accepts $translation keys

name: ui_newgame_gfx_banner_bg
doc: mod.xml only. Path to the background image of the game mode's new game menu banner, e.g. mods/<id>/files/menu_banner_background.png

name: ui_newgame_gfx_banner_fg
doc: mod.xml only. Path to the overlay image of the game mode's new game menu banner, e.g. mods/<id>/files/menu_banner_overlay.png

name: is_game_mode
doc: mod.xml only. If 1 this mod is a game mode: it isn't enabled from the mod list but started from the new game menu, using the ui_newgame_* attributes

name: game_mode_supports_save_slots
doc: mod.xml only. If 1 a game mode (is_game_mode="1") supports multiple save slots

name: is_translation
doc: mod.xml only. If 1 normal mod functionality is turned off and the mod is listed under Language in the options menu instead, using translation_xml_path and translation_csv_path

name: translation_xml_path
doc: mod.xml only. Path to the <Language> xml of a translation mod (language key, name, fonts, UI offsets), e.g. mods/<id>/translation.xml

name: translation_csv_path
doc: mod.xml only. Path to the translation csv of a translation mod, e.g. mods/<id>/translation.csv

name: tags
doc: workshop.xml only (ignored in mod.xml). Comma-separated Steam Workshop tags, spelled exactly as listed in tools_modding/READ_ME_FIRST.txt

name: dont_upload_folders
doc: workshop.xml only (ignored in mod.xml). Folders not to upload, separated with |, e.g. ignore_this|files\ignore_this_subfolder

name: dont_upload_files
doc: workshop.xml only (ignored in mod.xml). Files not to upload, separated with |, e.g. README.md|.gitignore

name: _format_version
doc: compatibility.xml only. Format version of this file

name: version_built_with
doc: compatibility.xml only. Game build number recorded for the mod
